title: First Real Producer Goal: Create a Dark, Sustained Bass Sound
goal: Create a dark, sustained bass sound

producer_loop_outcome.missing_capability: YES — Env 1 Sustain and Env 1 Release not in MCP surface
producer_loop_outcome.execute: PARTIAL — 4 admitted controls written to Serum 2

goal_decomposition: Filter cutoff low (low cutoff = dark character)

admitted_controls.label: Attack fast
admitted_controls.intent: Give the sound a faster attack

refused_controls.label: Sustain full
refused_controls.detail: Env 1 Sustain is not in Serum 2's 127-parameter MCP surface. Env 4 Sustain (index 103) is a different, auxiliary envelope. Mapping Env1.Sustain to Env 4 would silently write to the wrong parameter — refused.

refused_controls.label: Release long
refused_controls.detail: Env 1 Release is not in Serum 2's 127-parameter MCP surface. Env 4 Release (index 104) is a different, auxiliary envelope. Refused — same reason as Env 1 Sustain.

sonic_character_achieved: Filter engaged at 379 Hz (dark, low-cut character)
sonic_character_missing: Env 1 Sustain = uncontrolled (may default to 100% in current patch, may not)
Env 1 Release = uncontrolled (tail length unknown without MCP access)

discovery_request.goal: Create a dark, sustained bass sound

missing_capabilities.what_is_needed: Control of amplitude envelope sustain level (Env 1) via MCP
missing_capabilities.why_missing: Serum 2's 127-parameter MCP surface does not expose Env 1 Sustain or Env 1 Release. Only Env 1 Attack (index 12) is in the surface. Env 4 ADSR (indices 100-104) is present but is an auxiliary modulation envelope, not the amp envelope.
missing_capabilities.experiment_needed: Discover whether Env 1 Decay/Sustain/Release are accessible via Serum 2 Configure Mode (not just MCP surface). If exposable via Configure Mode as a 16th macro control, they can be added to Tier 1 (Macro Controls) and then accessed via a separate MCP path.
missing_capabilities.alternative: Verify that Serum 2's default patch has Env 1 Sustain=100% by default, which would mean sustained notes are 'sustained' without explicit control — reducing the criticality of this gap for held notes.

discovery_request.next_experiment: 16.5.63 — Probe whether Env 1 Decay/Sustain/Release can be exposed via Serum 2 Configure Mode (drag-drop to macro slot). If yes: add to Tier 1 and retry 16.5.62 goal.

producer_loop_verdict.description: The compiler correctly refused to map Env1.Sustain/Release to wrong parameters. 4/6 controls executed. Dark filter character achieved (379 Hz cutoff, 40% res). Sustain and release envelope control is the exact missing capability — now the target for the next knowledge-discovery experiment (16.5.63).
